name: Entity tab picture: render one entity in the entity page
body:
# Entity tab picture

The entity page has no picture of the entity yet. It needs a new editor C API function to render one entity alone (like
the template preview, but for a placed entity and its current values), a ViewportRenderer in apps/world-editor/nox and
a `renderer="entity"` viewport on the page. Not started: it touches engine/src/editor, the C API and the bridge host.
